test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_random (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_clustered (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()

CREATE TABLE t_sorted (x Nullable(UInt64) STATISTICS(basic), p1 UInt64, p2 UInt64, p3 UInt64, p4 UInt64, p5 UInt64, p6 UInt64, p7 UInt64, p8 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY x SETTINGS allow_nullable_key = 1
CREATE TABLE t_keys (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
